name: MonarchAiContextDivider
title: AiContextDivider
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Row with drawBehind hairlines and androidx.compose.material3.Text; MonarchCollapsible and MonarchButton for the controls
summary: A labelled rule between messages in a thread: a calendar day, a context reset, or a point where earlier messages were summarized, with the summary behind a disclosure.
whenToUse: In an AI conversation, to mark a new day, the point from which the assistant no longer sees earlier messages, or where earlier messages were condensed.
whenNotToUse: For a plain rule between content use MonarchDivider. For a section heading use MonarchText with a heading style.
api: @Composable fun MonarchAiContextDivider(kind: MonarchAiContextDividerKind, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, dateMillis: Long? = null, nowMillis: Long? = null, summary: String? = null, onExpand: (() -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchAiContextDividerLabels = MonarchAiContextDividerLabels())
enum class MonarchAiContextDividerKind { Day, ContextReset, Summarized }

class MonarchAiContextDividerLabels(label: String? = null, detail: String? = null, today: String? = null, yesterday: String? = null, showSummary: String? = null, summaryPrefix: String? = null, expand: String? = null)

options.name: dateMillis
options.description: The day of a Day divider, in epoch milliseconds (UTC). Without it a day divider has an empty label.

options.name: nowMillis
options.description: The reference time for Today and Yesterday. null is the current time.

options.name: summary
options.description: For Summarized: the summary the assistant now works from, shown behind a disclosure.

options.name: onExpand
options.description: For Summarized: shows a "Show earlier messages" button that calls this.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the label, the reset description, Today, Yesterday, "Show summary", the spoken summary prefix and "Show earlier messages".

states.name: day
states.description: The label is Today, Yesterday, a weekday and date in this year, or a full date. Solid subtle lines.

states.name: contextReset
states.description: The label, dashed lines and one line of description under them.

states.name: summarized
states.description: The label in the strong AI color and the lines in the AI border color. With a summary, a disclosure; with onExpand, a button.

states.name: summary expanded
states.description: The summary is shown in a box with the subtle AI fill and the AI border.

appearance: A centered caption between two hairlines. The lines use the subtle border role for a day, the default border role, dashed, for a reset, and the AI border role for a summary; the label is muted text, or the strong AI role for a summary. The summary box is the subtle AI fill with the AI border. All roles come from the theme.
platformNotes: The web takes locale, timeZone and now; on Android the locale comes from the configuration, the time zone is the device's, and only nowMillis is a parameter. Today and Yesterday are Monarch strings here, so they can be replaced, unlike iOS which uses the system relative formatter. Dates are epoch milliseconds and formatted with android.icu.text.DateFormat skeletons. The summary is a String, not arbitrary content. The disclosure is MonarchCollapsible, so its title is a full-width row. The web gives the divider the separator role; Compose has no separator role, so it is read as text, as on iOS. Built-in strings are replaced through one labels value.
accessibility: Without controls the divider is one TalkBack element whose content description is the label, then the description of a reset.
A context reset has dashed lines and its own text, so it does not depend on color.
With controls, the label, the disclosure header and the button are separate elements in reading order.
The summary is read after "AI-generated summary:", which is not shown.
The disclosure header and the button each have a 48dp touch target.
The lines are drawn and never read. Text grows with the font size setting and wraps.
edgeCases: A day divider without a date has an empty label and shows only the lines.
A long label wraps and stays centered; the lines keep a least length of 16dp.
summary and onExpand are ignored for Day and ContextReset.
Tomorrow and later days are shown as a date, not as a relative name.
The day is counted in the device time zone, so the same moment can be Today in one zone and Yesterday in another.

examples.title: Days
Summarized messages with the summary and a way back
examples.code:
MonarchAiContextDivider(
    kind = MonarchAiContextDividerKind.Summarized,
    summary = "The team agreed to ship the report on Friday.",
    onExpand = { showingEarlier = true },
)
